title: Paired Associates Learning: Memory for Word Pairs in Cued Recall
description: Intracranial EEG and behavioral event data from a paired associates learning task in which participants studied pairs of visually presented words, solved arithmetic distractor problems, and then performed cued recall. Data were collected from clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania. Recordings include monopolar and bipolar iEEG with subject-specific electrode montages, MNI/Talairach coordinates, and brain region annotations.
methods_description: Each session comprised 25 lists of encoding, distractor, and cued recall. During encoding, 6 word pairs were shown for 4000 ms each with a 1000 ms interstimulus interval. Arithmetic problems served as a distractor. In cued recall, one word from each pair was shown and participants vocally recalled its partner within 5000 ms.
